# Isaiah Chapter 20 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 6 verses]*

*Sign-act against Egypt and Cush; three years naked; warning against relying on Egypt*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Isaiah walked naked and barefoot three years as a sign. This chapter sign-act against egypt and cush.

*-- LOGOS*
